results.text: Pioglitazone increases risk of ischemic heart disease in patients with type 2 diabetes receiving insulin. Studies evaluating the cardiovascular safety of pioglitazone show inconsistent results and ischemic heart disease (IHD) risks associated with different anti-diabetic drugs added to metformin uncontrolled type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) are not assessed.
